name: Uptime Institute
description: New York advisory and certification body for digital infrastructure rather than an equipment vendor: it runs the Tier Standard and Tier certifications, management-and-operations reviews, risk, energy and sustainability assessments, education, and the Uptime Intelligence research service whose industry surveys the card's benchmarks draw on. Owned by The 451 Group.
notes: Registered as an advisory body, not a vendor: the card cites it for survey benchmarking and PUE guidance. PUE-specific guidance was not visible on the pages read, so a PUE standard is not attributed to it here; the 2019 451 Research sale to S&P Global left 451 Group focused on Uptime Institute, and no sale of Uptime Institute itself was found.
